login.title: Sign in
login.tagline: Google only — there is no password to forget.
login.failed: That sign-in did not go through.

aliases.title: Showdown names
aliases.tagline: Add every name you play under and they all count as the same you — after a rename, on an alt, on a separate account for a different format.
aliases.unverified: We cannot verify that a Showdown account is yours, and neither can anyone else: Showdown has no way for another site to check. These names only decide which of the battles you import are treated as your own — they grant nothing, and the same name may be on more than one person’s list.
aliases.label: Showdown name
aliases.empty: No names yet. Add the one you play under.
aliases.alreadyBound: {name} is already on your list. Names are compared without case or punctuation, so NotLittleStar and notlittlestar are the same name.
aliases.unusable: That is not a Showdown name — it needs at least one letter or digit.
aliases.loadFailed: We could not read your names, so nothing can be changed here right now. Reload the page to try again.
